entities.name: PMID:25440643
observations: Randomized, double-blind trial of intraoperative vasopressin 1.8 U/h versus saline during cardiac surgery; 92 patients analyzed, with CK-MB and troponin T measured at 0, 6, and 12 postoperative hours.

entities.name: Vasopressin
observations: In the trial, intraoperative infusion did not significantly increase postoperative cardiac enzyme values compared with saline.

entities.name: No enzyme increase
observations: In 92 cardiac-surgery patients, CK-MB and troponin T did not differ significantly between vasopressin and saline at 0, 6, or 12 hours postoperatively; the trial found no enzyme-raising effect.
